captured_by: F008 P1 GitHub matrix/assertion re-derivation (live re-capture)
sha256_original_note: sha256_original is the digest of the exact live bytes this capture was derived from on 2026-08-13. It is NOT reproducible across fetches: docs.github.com embeds per-build nonces, so a later fetch of an unchanged page yields a different digest. Structure, not digest, is the invariant.
tos_note: Official GitHub documentation (docs.github.com). https://docs.github.com/robots.txt contains only 'User-agent: *' with no Disallow rules, so automated retrieval of these paths is permitted. A minimal excerpt is committed for offline, deterministic extraction testing; every retained value and every pinned sentence is reproduced verbatim from the cited live page.
trim_method:
Removed scripts, navigation, styling and unrelated prose. Retained the target table verbatim (spliced out of the live markup, attributes included) and every prose block the profile pins. Inline markup inside the retained prose blocks (anchors, SVG icons, nested

inside

  • ) was flattened to plain text. The engine normalises a block to its text content, so the normalised block string is byte-identical to live; this was verified by matching each pinned assertion against the live document's own collected blocks.
live_table_note: The live page publishes this allowance table with plan ROWS and metric COLUMNS. A matrix profile pivots one tier column across row labels, so the profile declares the live plan column as its metric header and one live metric column as its tier column. Every live plan row is declared, so a plan GitHub adds later rejects the document instead of being dropped.
